[RTCT.6.10] **`Json` caps.** `json_depth_cap` (field 17), `json_node_cap`
(field 18), `json_string_bytes_cap` (field 19) and `json_text_bytes_cap`
(field 20), all `uint32`, lower the four fixed `Json` limits of [LGRA.5.8.6]
for the tier. `0`, the proto3 default and omitted on the wire, means the fixed
maximum. A non-zero value above its fixed maximum is `DS_ERR_CONTRACT_INVALID`:
a contract may lower a limit and may not raise one. A value over a lowered limit
is refused as one over the fixed limit is ([LGRA.5.8.6]).
